# Bobsome1.com

Bobsome1.com is the public home of Project Unveiled by Robert J. Hayes.

## Primary resources
- Homepage: https://bobsome1.com/
- Project Unveiled overview: https://bobsome1.com/book/
- Complete reader directory: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/
- Begin Chapter One: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/chapter-01.html
- Interactive historical timeline: https://bobsome1.com/book/timeline.html
- Research standards and corrections: https://bobsome1.com/book/research.html
- Works consulted: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/appendix-e.html
- Support Right Hand Ministry: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/support-right-hand.html
- Privacy: https://bobsome1.com/privacy.html

## Content notes
Project Unveiled is a complete public edition with 13 chapters and supporting appendices. It distinguishes documented history, interpretation, theological argument, and open questions. Corrections and stronger evidence are welcomed.
